'''''Minuartia recurva''''', the '''recurved sandwort''' or '''sickle-leaved sandwort''',<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/MTIRE|title=Minuartia recurva (MTIRE)[Overview]- EPPO Global Database|website=gd.eppo.int}}</ref> is a rare tufted, [[Calcifuge|calcifugous]] [[Subshrub|chamaephyte]] [[perennial plant|perennial]] flowering plant in the family [[Caryophyllaceae]]. It blooms from late spring to the end of summer.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/4325/|title=Application of High Resolution Melting analysis for haplotype detection in phylogeographic research and case studies of Arenaria ciliata, A. norvegica and Minuartia recurva (Caryophyllaceae)|first=Xiaodong|last=Dang|date=1 September 2012|publisher=|via=mural.maynoothuniversity.ie}}</ref>

==Description==
This perennial, densely tufted, hairy plant has a woody base and flowering stems up to {{Convert|15|cm|in|0|abbr=on}} in length. The stems are wiry and lignified, with acicular leaves with three veins, curving to the side to a greater of lesser extent. The flowers are grouped in glandular flower-heads, the individual flowers being white and five-petaled. The [[inflorescence]] is a 1–8-flowered cyme. Sepals are {{convert|3|to|6|mm|2|abbr=on}} long with 5–7 veins and are ovate-lanceolate; petals are {{convert|4|to|8|mm|2|abbr=on}} long and ovate. The fruit is an ovoid capsule up to {{convert|5|mm|in|2|abbr=on}} in length.<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=U_PU2vC5bwsC&q=recurva&pg=PA192|title=The European Garden Flora: A Manual for the Identification of Plants Cultivated in Europe, Both Out-of-doors and Under Glass|first1=Stuart Max|last1=Walters|first2=James|last2=Cullen|date=10 April 1984|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=9780521361712|via=Google Books}}</ref>

==Distribution==
''Minuartia recurva'' is found in mountainous regions of [[southern Europe]] and [[southwest Asia]].

It is also found in [[Ireland]]'s [[Caha Mountains]], first noted there in 1964.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.brc.ac.uk/plantatlas/plant/minuartia-recurva|title=Minuartia recurva - Online Atlas of the British and Irish Flora|website=www.brc.ac.uk}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://bsbi.org/wp-content/uploads/dlm_uploads/IrBotNews2000.pdf |title=Irish botanical news: March 2000 |pages=32, 42 |year=2000 |publisher=The Committee for Ireland Botanical Society of the British Isles |accessdate=30 March 2020}}</ref>
